FAQ

Frequently asked.

Everything you want to know before you start. Still have questions? Book a demo.

The basics

What is Parallel AI?

The all-in-one AI platform for business growth: AI employees built on every major model, Smart Lists lead generation, multi-channel sequences, a content engine, always-on support agents, and native n8n workflow automation — one platform connected to 1,000+ tools.

What can AI employees actually do?

They do the work, not just answer questions. Build unlimited AI employees on the latest frontier models, each trained on your business and connected to your tools — they qualify leads, draft campaigns, resolve tickets, publish content and run workflows. Set them on an autonomous heartbeat and they wake on their own schedule and keep working overnight.

Which AI models are included?

OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and more — with new models added within days of release, included in your subscription.

Do I need technical skills?

No coding required. Free onboarding builds your ideal customer profile, lead list, outreach sequence, content and website agent for you — and day to day you direct the platform in plain English.

Pricing & billing

What do I get for free when I sign up?

Free in-app onboarding builds your content strategy, social and blog posts, in-market leads with an email outreach sequence, and an AI agent ready to go on your website. Credits are on us to start — no credit card required.

How does pricing work?

Start free on Pay As You Go — 50 free credits, access to every feature, no monthly fee and no credit card. Paid plans start at $99/month, and you can top up with credit packs that never expire. Full plan details are in the pricing section above.

Are there any hidden fees?

No. You pay your subscription cost and that’s it — new features and AI models are included in updates.

Platform & integrations

Does it integrate with the tools I already use?

Yes — 1,000+ integrations including Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn, Notion and Shopify, plus native n8n workflows, a full REST API and MCP access.

Can I run Parallel AI without opening the app?

Yes — Parallel AI is the first headless GTM platform. Every feature — Smart Lists, sequences, the content engine, AI employees, workflows — is executable by your Executive Assistant over text, and the same control is available to any MCP client. Every action is logged and reviewable.

Can it answer calls and support my customers?

Yes. Deploy AI receptionists and support agents across phone, SMS, WhatsApp, web chat and email, 24/7/365. They qualify leads, book meetings, answer product questions and update your CRM — and hand complex issues to your team with full context.

Is my data secure?

Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit, never used to train AI models, and governed by controls independently examined against the AICPA Trust Services Criteria. See our security practices.

Can I white-label Parallel AI for my clients?

Yes. Agencies launch their own fully branded AI platform — your logo, your domain, your pricing — in days. See the white-label platform.
